csv_project_name: DB for Fire Suppression System Installation
csv_scope_of_work: Installation of a Wet Fire Suppression System. Contractor shall provide Design/As-Built drawings submittals and installation for a new retrofitted system starting at a flange one foot above the floor in building 6418. The system shall be a turnkey project encompassing everything needed to have a fully functioning fire suppression system. The contractor shall remove and dispose of all construction materials and debris off base.
